scenes.narration: At 3:33 a.m. my flashlight lit something taller than the hallway.
The power went out. I woke up to total black. I found my phone and turned on the light. I walked into the hallway.
The beam showed the floor first. Then the wall. Then a long stretch of ceiling that seemed higher than it should be.
Something stood at the far end. Tall. Narrow. Too tall for the door frame. It did not move. It was leaning very slightly to listen.
I held the light steady. The shape did not grow. It simply came closer without walking. Every time I blinked.
I whispered, Dad? The shape bent. Slowly. As if it was copying my voice instead of answering.
My phone was at ten percent. The beam flickered. The shape was close enough that I could feel the air move.
Then it breathed out. One long breath. The flashlight went dark, like someone had blown out a candle.
So tell me. In total black, do you run for the stairs, or stay perfectly still?
